newsitem.title: USA: PETSMART SEES Q2 BELOW STREET ESTIMATES.
newsitem.headline: PETSMART SEES Q2 BELOW STREET ESTIMATES.

text.p: PETsMART Inc said it expects to report net income, excluding merger and restructuring charges, for the 1997 second quarter in the range of $0.02 and $0.04 a share, which is below the Wall Street consensus estimate.
PETsMART also will record charges of $60-$65 million or $36.9-$40 million after taxes ($0.32-$0.35/shr) in the second quarter.

About $42 million to $47 million will be recorded as a restructuring charge and about $18 million will be recorded as a component of cost of sales, store operating expenses or general and administrative expenses.
